description: Solana address math: op=pda (program + seeds as hex strings → program-derived address and bump), ata (owner + mint [+ token_program] → associated token account), on_curve (address → is it an ed25519 point), anchor_disc (instruction name, e.g. initialize → 8-byte discriminator). Pure, offline computation (blocktools); nothing is fetched or stored. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
name: solana_address
title: Solana PDA / ATA / on-curve / Anchor discriminator (dev tool)
